data.one_liner: Custom gesture detector widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom gesture detector widget that allows users to perform custom drawn gestures using lines in specified axes directions. Triggers a callback when the gesture sequence ends successfully.
use_when: You need custom shape or line-based gesture recognition in your app
Users need to input custom drawn patterns or directional gesture sequences
avoid_when: You only need standard Flutter gestures like taps, double taps, or basic pans
You need complex machine learning-based gesture or handwriting recognition
strengths: Easy to integrate widget for custom gesture detection
Supports null safety and hit behavior forwarding
weaknesses: Limited built-in documentation and gesture types shown in the example
